authority: Hermes freeze precondition 1 — matcher written and committed BEFORE class rerun

incomparable_prior.rule: Do not cite 28 again in any artifact or summary, including as a range or approximation. No persisted capability-only artifact and no matcher metadata exist for that run.

question_set.filter: rows where (type||'find')==='find', then slice(0,40) in file order
question_set.note: git hash-object / git rev-parse HEAD:path of the benchmark file at freeze time

normalization.expect_path: String(expect[0]).replace(/^\.\//,'') — strip leading ./ only; no other path normalization
normalization.surface_bytes: readFileSync utf8 as stored on disk; no NFC/NFD normalize; no line-ending normalize

explicitly_disabled: symlink realpath rewriting of expect or surface
match_rules.context_policy: A hit counts regardless of surrounding context: comments, URLs, markdown code fences, JSON string values, and prose all count. No exclusion by AST or comment-stripping.
match_rules.aggregation: A question is a candidate if ANY enabled predicate hits on ANY present surface in the class. Evidence records every (surface, predicate) hit with a ±40 char snippet around the first indexOf match (full_path preferred when both hit on the same surface).

must_embed: per-surface content sha256 at scan time
